context: Security audit of attemptEscalation in android/app/src/main/java/com/scmessenger/android/transport/TransportManager.kt. Function extracted from recent changes (last 7 days).

claims.text: No check if WiFi Aware/WiFi Direct are actually connected to the target peerId before marking as active
Unconditionally sets activeTransports to true without verifying the transport can actually reach peerId
No backoff or rate limiting on escalation attempts - could spam transport init
